problem.formula: du/dt + (u·grad)u = -grad p + nu nabla^2 u + f
problem.description: Taylor-Green vortex on 64x64 grid, nu=0.01, incompressible flow
problem.millennium_problem: Clay Mathematics Institute: global existence and smoothness
problem.classical_hardness: Nonlinear PDE, turbulence regime, no general existence proof
problem.quantum_approach: Quantum lattice Boltzmann encoding, VQE solves steady-state flow
